summary: Project Manager Abigail led the kick-off meeting with Marketing (Chiara), UI Designer (Stephanie), and Industrial Designer (Krista) to design an original, user-friendly remote control. The target selling price is set at 25 Euros with a profit goal of 50 million Euros on 4 million units sold internationally. Key features discussed include an easy-to-find mechanism (call button or vibration), hand-held sizing with minimal buttons, a display screen, water resistance, and a clip.
decisions: Target selling price set at 25 Euros per unit
Profit goal set at 50 million Euros with a sales target of 4 million units (50% margin)
Remote control will be hand-held sized with minimal physical buttons
Remote control must be water-resistant and include a clip feature

action_items.task: Investigate physical working design and structure (screen and housing)
Define technical functions and user interaction mechanisms
Research user requirements and market data
